intake.line: Strong Culture Fit: Prava slides a laminated org chart across the desk and tells Milo his forty-one years of pointless optimization are an asset; for the first time in decades he feels seen, and he accepts the placement in Reconciliations before anyone thinks to offer him a choice.

partition.line: Lanyard, Desk, Mentor: Milo is issued a lanyard and walked into the windowless, clockless Marrow District, where he gushes to his assigned trainer Zara Okafor; her flat, unbroken courtesy is the first thing he misreads as friendship.

bell.line: Halvard Bell's Account: Milo is handed his first restructured account: Halvard Bell, a former dentist who spent ninety years in Retention and was restructured at nine that morning. He zeroes the tenure cleanly and only afterwards notices that the destination field reads 'under'.

summons.line: All-Staff: The work stoppage begins with an all-staff email that is, for once, entirely honest; the Marrow District goes quiet in a new way, and Milo is summoned to the quarterly review in the corner office.

corner office.line: Mr. Voss: In the office no employee leaves unchanged, Edric Thane receives Milo with measured, ledger-bound courtesy and recognises in him the clerk he once was; Milo, stammering through his corporate hedges, holds out a single sheet of paper anyway.

discrepancy.line: A Routine Account: Closing an ordinary restructured file, Milo's tally comes up short: the soul's tenure leaves the ledger faster than any labour or fee schedule can explain, and his professional pride will not let the discrepancy go.
